name: Taxes
descr: The taxes of the store. A group holds the rates, and a goods points at a group by its tax_group_id - the Price tool writes that column, not this one. The areas are a tree of their own - a country, a region inside it - and a rule is what ties a rate to an area; a rule may carry a value of its own instead of the one its rate names. The options declared for the areas live in the registry of the additional options, place tax_area, and only the rows set on the areas are written here.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the tax groups and nothing beside them. The rates, the areas, their rules and the option rows come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the whole of the taxes - the groups, their rates, the tree of the areas, the rules tying a rate to an area and the option rows on the areas: five tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a tax group at the end of the list. It takes nothing off a goods until a rate stands in it.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of tax groups, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the tax group, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes tax groups by id. The first call counts what goes with them and how many goods point at them, the second one does it: tax_group_id is emptied on those goods, and the rates of the groups - with the rules standing on those rates - are swept by the map of the engine.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the tax group, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

params.name: relation
params.descr: true - the references pointing at these rows are emptied as well; left out, they stay as they are

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the tax groups in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdRateAdd
commands.descr: Adds a rate to a tax group, at the end of its list. A rate takes a per cent, a sum, or both - what the program shows is what stands in the columns.

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the tax group the rate belongs to

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_RATE_KIND_KEY

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the rate

params.name: rate_proc
params.descr: the per cent the rate takes

params.name: rate_sum
params.descr: the sum the rate takes

params.name: rate_sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its group; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdRateUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of rates, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was. A rate moves to another group by group_id, and the rules that named it move with it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rate, or several of them

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the tax group the rate belongs to

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_RATE_KIND_KEY

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the rate

params.name: rate_proc
params.descr: the per cent the rate takes

params.name: rate_sum
params.descr: the sum the rate takes

params.name: rate_sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its group

commands.name: CmdRateRemove
commands.descr: Deletes rates by id. The first call counts the rules standing on them, the second one does it - those rules go with the rates, swept by the map of the engine.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rate, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdAreaAdd
commands.descr: Adds an area under a parent, or at the top of the tree when parent_id is 0. A folder only groups others; an area meets a rate through a rule, and an area with no rule of its own follows the areas above it.

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the area it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the area

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the area

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others

params.name: code
params.descr: the code of the area, the one the outside world names it by

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_AREA_KIND_KEY

params.name: type_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_AREA_TYPE_KEY - a country, a region

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the area, as the program keeps them

commands.name: CmdAreaUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of areas, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the area, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the area

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the area

params.name: folder
params.descr: true - a folder that only groups others

params.name: code
params.descr: the code of the area, the one the outside world names it by

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_AREA_KIND_KEY

params.name: type_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_AREA_TYPE_KEY - a country, a region

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the area, as the program keeps them

commands.name: CmdAreaMove
commands.descr: Moves an area under another parent, with the branch under it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the area to move

params.name: parent_id
params.descr: id of the area it goes under; 0 puts it at the top of the tree

commands.name: CmdAreaRemove
commands.descr: Deletes areas by id, with the branch under them. The first call counts what goes - the rules of those areas and the option rows set on them - the second one does it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the area, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

commands.name: CmdRuleAdd
commands.descr: Ties a rate to an area: one rule. Left plain the rule takes what its rate says; with rule_custom it takes the per cent and the sum written here instead.

params.name: area_id
params.descr: id of the area the rule stands on

params.name: rate_id
params.descr: id of the rate the rule names

params.name: rule_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_RULE_KEY

params.name: rule_custom
params.descr: true - the rule takes its own per cent and sum, not the ones of its rate

params.name: rule_proc
params.descr: the per cent of the rule itself

params.name: rule_sum
params.descr: the sum of the rule itself

params.name: rule_sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

commands.name: CmdRuleUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of rules, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was. A rule moves to another area or another rate by area_id and rate_id.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rule, or several of them

params.name: area_id
params.descr: id of the area the rule stands on

params.name: rate_id
params.descr: id of the rate the rule names

params.name: rule_key
params.descr: a value of TAX_RULE_KEY

params.name: rule_custom
params.descr: true - the rule takes its own per cent and sum, not the ones of its rate

params.name: rule_proc
params.descr: the per cent of the rule itself

params.name: rule_sum
params.descr: the sum of the rule itself

params.name: rule_sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

commands.name: CmdRuleRemove
commands.descr: Deletes rules by id. The area keeps whatever the areas above it say, and the rate stays in its group.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rule, or several of them

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on areas: one row of tax_area_key_set on each of them. The option and its value must stand in the tree of the area options, and a stray id is refused.

params.name: tax_area_id
params.descr: id of the area, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the registry of the additional options answers the tree of them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of tax_area_key_set, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A row keeps whatever the call leaves out, and the pair it will stand with is weighed against the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of tax_area_key_set, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the registry of the additional options answers the tree of them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of tax_area_key_set by id. The option itself stays in the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of tax_area_key_set, or several of them
